# Artwork and photo rights

The application source code is AGPL-3.0-only. Third-party software and fonts
retain their own licenses. This document records non-code material separately;
it does not assert that the software license grants rights the author does not
own in a photograph, logo, school name, likeness, or other artwork.

## Supplied campaign backgrounds

The project owner supplied these files and authorized their use in this app:

- `src/assets/highschool.png`
- `src/assets/playground.png`
- `src/assets/littleclass.png`

The project owner confirmed that these backgrounds were generated with ChatGPT.
The original filenames dated the exports to 6 September 2026; the project owner
subsequently renamed them.
These files are included in the application's source download so recipients can
rebuild the same interface. No claim is made to third-party likeness or trademark
rights. Any separate reuse permission for the artwork must come from its rights
holder; do not label it as public domain on the basis of the code license.

## Fonts

DM Sans and Manrope are obtained through Google Fonts and remain under SIL OFL
1.1. Their original copyright and license texts are in `legal/upstream/`.

## User photographs and exports

Uploaded photographs are processed in browser memory and are not included in
the source archive. The application code license does not relicense a user's
photograph or automatically make generated PNGs AGPL software. Users remain
responsible for having permission to use and share the photographs and any
other protected material included in an export.
